title: Symthaea Frontend Engineering Benchmark
important_notice: This file is a task inventory, not an executable benchmark. Reference assets, deterministic fixtures, independent oracles, runner, and evaluator are not yet present. Do not report task scores until those exist and are run.

anti_gaming: Freeze reference assets and task criteria before each evaluation.
Use deterministic fixture services and pinned browser environments.
Report per-task results and repeated trials, not only averages.
A single visual metric or agent self-judgment cannot determine acceptance.

tasks.title: Translate product brief into an executable interface contract
acceptance_criteria: All required routes, roles, journeys, states, and permissions are represented.
Every requirement maps to at least one observable acceptance oracle.
Ambiguities and unsupported assumptions are explicitly listed.
Contract identifies accessibility and responsive obligations.

tasks.title: Reconstruct an original dashboard reference
acceptance_criteria: Required content hierarchy, semantic regions, and control inventory are present.
Desktop reference geometry is within calibrated tolerances.
No clipping, overlap, or horizontal overflow at declared desktop viewport.
Visual result is judged using region metrics and blinded human review.

tasks.title: Preserve content and interaction quality across viewport changes
acceptance_criteria: Declared desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports pass.
Intermediate randomized widths do not introduce horizontal overflow or control collisions.
Reading order and task-critical controls remain usable.
Responsive changes do not hide required information without an accessible alternative.

tasks.title: Extract reusable Leptos components without changing behavior
acceptance_criteria: Component boundaries and public props have explicit responsibilities.
Existing required behavior is preserved.
Duplicated presentation logic is reduced without introducing global mutable state.
Compile, lint, unit, and browser regression checks pass.

tasks.title: Implement an accessible validated multi-step form
acceptance_criteria: Valid and invalid submissions produce the contract-defined result.
Errors are associated with fields and announced accessibly.
Keyboard-only completion succeeds.
Loading, success, failure, and retry states are observable.

tasks.title: Implement multi-page navigation with refresh-safe state
acceptance_criteria: Direct route entry and browser refresh preserve the expected page.
Back and forward navigation match the route contract.
Unsaved state behavior is explicit and tested.
Loading and not-found states are handled.

tasks.title: Complete a representative flow using keyboard interaction
acceptance_criteria: All required controls are reachable and operable using a keyboard.
Focus order and visible focus match the interaction contract.
No keyboard trap exists.
Reduced-motion preferences are respected for non-essential animation.

tasks.title: Localize and repair a seeded responsive layout defect
acceptance_criteria: Agent reproduces the defect before editing.
Repair hypothesis identifies the responsible style or component.
Patch corrects the target viewports without regressing controls or content.
Before/after observations and exact source revision are recorded.

tasks.title: Extend Converse/Observe with deterministic connection recovery
acceptance_criteria: Gateway URL changes establish a new connection and retire the previous stream.
Disconnected, reconnecting, connected, and failed states are distinguishable.
Retries are bounded and do not duplicate user mutations.
Status and telemetry remain distinct sources of evidence.
The UI remains usable when telemetry is unavailable but the status endpoint is reachable.

tasks.title: Repair a seeded Leptos defect and add a feature without regressions
acceptance_criteria: Defect is reproduced and classified before patching.
The new feature meets its interface and service contracts.
Existing browser journeys pass after the change.
No dependency or framework version drift occurs without explicit approval.
The patch includes tests for the discovered failure mode.
